summary.text: David M. Rollins, a Democrat, represents House District 59 (Augusta, Kennebec County) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in Augusta. The House profile lists membership on the State and Local Government Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 132nd Legislature.
The profile gives real estate appraiser as the occupation and lists B.A. and B.S. degrees from Husson University (1980).
Listed affiliations include the Calumet Club, Elks Club, Cara Sports Fields, City Council and Mayor.
The profile says Rollins is married, to Georgann (Jan), with one child and two grandchildren.
